_meta.method: Page reads through the platform's page-fetch tool, one read per URL. No login, form, checkout or access control used or bypassed. Prices and star ratings visible on the live pages were deliberately NOT copied into the site (Participation Requirements 2(b) and 6(t)); they appear only inside page-source URLs fetched during the reads and are not recorded here as data values.
